evidence.title: Fusion README.md
evidence.locator: Quick start; Core features; Multi-node; Provider authentication; Scheduled tasks
evidence.finding: Early-preview self-hosted coding factory with planning/review workflows, persistent tasks, worktree execution, agent mail, desktop/web/mobile clients and daemon-owned schedules/webhooks.

evidence.title: Fusion docs/settings-reference.md
evidence.locator: Provider authentication; Scheduling; Workflow settings; Per-task budgets
evidence.finding: Anthropic subscription OAuth and API-key auth are separate; explicit pi-claude-cli runs local Claude. Scheduling has per-project/system/workflow concurrency, worktree caps, verification cap and retry/timeouts. Usage costs are provider-qualified estimates, not bills.

evidence.title: Fusion docs/mcp.md
evidence.finding: Fusion configures trusted MCP definitions per global/project scope and forwards enabled servers to compatible lanes. Stdio, SSE and streamable HTTP supported; secret references materialized at use.

evidence.title: Fusion docs/task-management.md
evidence.locator: Task Creation Options; Duplicate guard; Metadata
evidence.finding: Persistent tasks have IDs, metadata, status and configurable workflows. Task create has similarity/exact duplicate guards with explicit bypasses and fail-open limitations. CLI and agent tools share deterministic duplicate handling.

evidence.title: Fusion docs/agents.md
evidence.locator: Agent runtime; Heartbeat; Task assignment; Inter-agent messages
evidence.finding: Durable agents have roles, identity/memory and scoped tools for creating/delegating/assigning tasks, agent messaging and runtime coordination. Engineering backlog auto-claim is opt-in; executor pickup is default.

evidence.title: Fusion docs/sandbox.md
evidence.locator: Linux bubblewrap; macOS sandbox-exec; Task sessions
evidence.finding: Optional experimental OS sandbox backends are distinct from Git worktrees. Default is native; fail-hard or fallback-native behavior is configurable. Writable/network boundaries vary by backend.

evidence.title: Fusion LICENSE
evidence.finding: MIT source license at the pinned revision.

evidence.title: Fusion README

evidence.finding: Fusion works with many model providers and local runtimes via the user's own API keys or logins; the README calls it MIT open source and states no price.

evidence.title: Fusion MOBILE.md: PWA installation
evidence.locator: MOBILE.md lines 61-77 (PWA Installation) and README.md lines 318-320, commit eb7eef4
evidence.finding: The dashboard ships a PWA manifest and service worker; users install it from Chrome (Install app) or iOS Safari (Add to Home Screen) over HTTPS. The README presents the installable PWA beside the Capacitor iOS and Android apps for steering runs from a phone.

evidence.title: Fusion release v0.77.0 assets
evidence.locator: Release v0.77.0 (2026-09-02, tag commit a830cde) asset list
evidence.finding: The latest stable release attaches Windows x64 desktop installers, an Android APK and fn CLI binaries for Linux and Windows; it attaches no macOS or Linux desktop build and no iOS build.

evidence.title: Fusion Antigravity support at v0.77.0
evidence.finding: Fusion v0.77.0 explicitly hides deprecated Google Gemini CLI and Antigravity model-provider entries. That provider restriction does not establish whether Fusion can run the Antigravity coding harness.

evidence.title: Fusion: plugins/fusion-plugin-cursor-runtime/src/runtime-adapter.ts
evidence.locator: Cursor plugin README and adapter; plugins/fusion-plugin-grok-runtime; plugins/fusion-plugin-acp-runtime
evidence.finding: Installable runtime plugins launch Cursor Agent with stream-json output and Grok CLI through its ACP server. The generic ACP runtime README explicitly names Gemini CLI (gemini --acp), supports user-configured ACP binaries and is installed on demand as experimental. These coding runtimes are distinct from OpenAI/Codex or Google model-provider authentication.

evidence.title: Fusion: packages/dashboard/src/auth-middleware.ts
evidence.locator: Dashboard auth/token middleware; routes/register-chat-room-routes.ts; core/src sandbox backends and settings; core/chat persistence
evidence.finding: Dashboard API uses an operator daemon bearer token, with local unauthenticated mode available. Agent room owner/member roles are not human permissions; there is no named human team-role/SSO service. Multiple authorized browser clients can send messages to the same persisted room through the product endpoint; those requests share one operator identity. Runtime supports native, bubblewrap, Seatbelt, Docker/Podman and custom sandbox backends. No vendor-operated runtime or native VM provisioner is implemented. App settings expose no product telemetry-disable control.

evidence.title: Fusion container sandbox backend
evidence.locator: ContainerSandboxBackend, sandbox/index.ts resolution; core settings SandboxBackendName
evidence.finding: Sandbox backend settings include docker and podman. ContainerSandboxBackend executes task commands with the selected container runtime, binds the task cwd/worktree and applies network/resource configuration. Native/Seatbelt/bubblewrap and a custom backend are separate choices.
